mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the brush into the body was the most worthwhile step: it connected the main parts, and the description explained how the wheel and gears would turn the brush. The sweeper itself is an interesting mechanism, though assembling it was mostly following instructions.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second wheel was a simple instruction I followed to finish the project. It felt fine, though there was little to work out.

surprise.text: The description after fitting the brush explained that the wheel's large gear turns the brush gear the other way and the bristles flick crumbs into the hopper.

arbitrary.text: I fitted each part because the goals instructed me to; their purposes were clear enough, so that felt fine rather than wasteful.

continue.text: I would stop here. I understand the described sweeper mechanism, but the straightforward fittings did not make me curious enough to build another project.
